whole_lifecycle_findings.finding: matches counts occupied slots using ordered branches: two CompositableLensItem slots and one glue-tag slot, irrespective of stack counts. It does not debit or call compatibility. After second lens, an extra CompositableLensItem could occupy glue branch if an external loaded tag also names it; exact current tag disjointness is unverified.

First encountered lens owns canCombine and BOTH getCompositeLens calls, including lookup on the second stack; second implementation is not reciprocally invoked despite API prose. Custom cross-mod accessors are not automatically interchangeable. assemble separately rejects incompatibility/composite inputs and may return EMPTY after matches true.

Built-in lenses require distinct item objects, both combinable (normal lens refused), and disjoint property bits. Distinct PROP_NONE lenses overlap zero bits and remain eligible. Registration variants are one parameterized policy, not separate implementations.

Base and nested each copied count1; base ordinary metadata copied, nested saved id/count/tag/ForgeCaps into compositeLens. of reconstructs registered items, verifies tags/initializes caps; RuntimeException returns EMPTY. This is specific functional payload, not names or generic base-item identity. Removed/invalid IDs and arbitrary capabilities are not guaranteed recoverable.

Existence check lacks compound-type validation; wrong typed key becomes new empty compound through native getCompound, then loader may yield EMPTY. Null-for-missing and empty malformed compound are different. No claim of arbitrary malformed payload preservation.

Split accepts one occupied BasicLensItem (broader than Compositable) exposing a nonempty nested result, outputs count1 nested copy. Remainder independently copies outer count1 and removes compositeLens only. getRemainingItems has no own full-grid validation; native matching manager normally selects it. Do not directly invoke recipe methods as rewards or migrations.

Native onTake reselects matching remainder recipe, removes one from each occupied slot, merges same-tag remainder into grid or inventory/drop. Base remainder is not a second unpaid item. Glue is not reconstructed by split. Composite default remainders can return a glue container when the actual item defines one; no universal glue loss or refund is inferred. Callback-induced grid mutation/reselection is not tested transactionally.

apply/collide/update dispatch base then nested BasicLens. Control/transfer methods remain primary-only. Nested payload is functionally read, but neither complete lens implementations nor burst behavior/visuals are executed or separately credited.

Registry binds two constructor serializers; datagen derives dynamic/composite_lens and dynamic/split_lens IDs. No dynamic JSON/network fields. Special builder emits no advancement by itself, not evidence no separate recipe-crafted criterion can observe it. Current generated raw resources are four gaps.

Special catalog getter EMPTY is expected; server assembles enabled result for preview/sync. Quick-move calls item onCraftedBy BEFORE inventory move success. Preview/JEI/name or item callback alone does not prove payment or acquisition.

Item crafted stat/callback, Forge event and recipe trigger occur before per-slot debit/remainders. Special recipes also trigger; special branch retains used recipe reference rather than clearing it. No exact-once after-payment transaction or exploit is asserted; a future reward adapter must establish its own actual committed result path.

Criterion observes recipe ID and ingredient predicates, not output. new ArrayList copies the input LIST only: ItemStack references are not deep-copied here. One matching input element is removed per predicate; no output-NBT proof. Corrects original proposal loose phrase copies of input stacks.
